verifications.claim: More than 3 million bottles of eye drops manufactured by K.C. Pharmaceuticals were recalled in April 2026 due to potential contamination.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "More than three million bottles... manufactured... K.C. Pharmaceuticals... The FDA initiated the recall on March 3." (R2); "in March 2026, eye drops made by K.C. Pharmaceuticals were recalled... over 3 million bottles" (R3); "lack of assurance of sterility" across sources.
verifications.reasoning: Number of bottles, manufacturer, and reason (lack of sterility implies potential contamination) supported, but recall initiated in March 2026, not April.

verifications.claim: Key recalled products manufactured by K.C. Pharmaceuticals include Dry Eye Relief Eye Drops 0.5 fl. oz., Artificial Tears Sterile Lubricant Eye Drops 0.5 fl. oz., Sterile Eye Drops Original Formula 0.5 fl. oz., Sterile Eye Drops Redness Lubricant 0.5 fl. oz., Eye Drops Advanced Relief 0.5 fl. oz., Ultra Lubricating Eye Drops 0.5 fl. oz., Sterile Eye Drops AC 0.5 fl. oz., Sterile Eye Drops Soothing Tears 0.5 fl. oz.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: 1,023,096 bottles of Dry Eye Relief Drops...589,848 bottles of Artificial Tears Sterile Lubricant Eye Drops...378,144 bottles of Sterile Eye Drops Original Formula...315,144 bottles of Sterile Eye Drops Redness Lubricant...303,216 bottles of Eye Drops (advanced relief)...245,184 bottles of Ultra Lubricating Eye Drops...182,484 bottles of Sterile Eye Drops AC...74,016 bottles of Sterile Eye Drops Soothing Tears... all 0.5 fl. oz. (15 mL)" (R2, matching exactly in R3, R4, etc.).
verifications.reasoning: The exact product names and sizes are directly listed in multiple references for K.C. Pharmaceuticals recall.

verifications.claim: The recalled products were sold under various store brand labels including CVS Health, Walgreens, Rite Aid, Walmart (Equate), Target (Up&Up), Leader (Cardinal Health), Rugby, Meijer, Harris Teeter, H-E-B, Kroger, Publix, Good Neighbor Pharmacy, Good Sense, Velocity Pharma.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "Walgreens, CVS, Rite Aid, Harris Teeter, Kroger, Publix, Good Neighbor Pharmacy, Good Sense and Meijer" (R2); R3 lists CVS Health, Walgreens, Rite Aid, Leader, Rugby, Meijer, Harris Teeter, H-E-B, Kroger, Publix, Good Neighbor Pharmacy, Good Sense, Equaline; R1 lists Target Up&Up, Walmart Equate, Leader (Cardinal Health), Rugby, Velocity Pharma.
verifications.reasoning: Most brands (CVS Health, Walgreens, Rite Aid, Leader, Rugby, Meijer, Harris Teeter, H-E-B, Kroger, Publix, Good Neighbor Pharmacy, Good Sense) directly supported for K.C. recall; Walmart (Equate), Target (Up&Up), Velocity Pharma associated mainly with 2023 recall (R1), less precise support.

verifications.claim: The recall involves items with expiration dates between November 2023 and September 2025.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "AR24D01 (4/30/26)...SY24K02 (9/30/26)" all 2026 (R3); "expiration dates ranging from April 30 to July 31, 2026" (R6); "expiration dates ranging from April to October" (R8).
verifications.reasoning: Expiration dates for K.C. Pharmaceuticals recall are in 2026 (April-October), directly contradicting 2023-2025.
